in_arabic.name: Farqad
in_arabic.long_meaning: Farqad هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Means the one who is determined and victorious. Derived from the Arabic root 'farqa' which means to separate, to distinguish, and to excel.
